Shared.TransformTitle: Ready to transform your retail experience
Shared.TransformP1: Go paperless and reduce waste with digital receipts.
Shared.TransformP2: Earn rewards with every purchase from partnered brands.
Shared.TransformP3: Easily track spending and manage receipts in one place.
Shared.Heading-text1: Founded in 2025, with a clear vision for the future Quitty was launched with a simple yet powerful mission: to revolutionize the way receipts, warranty certificates, and payment reminders are handled. The idea arose from the need to create an efficient and sustainable solution that benefits both retailers and consumers. Our digital platform eliminates paper receipts, enables clear management of warranties, and sets automatic reminders - all in a single, intuitive app. Through this innovation, we help businesses reduce their ecological footprint, increase operational efficiency, and improve customer loyalty at the same time. We firmly believe that the future of retail lies in smart technology, environmentally conscious decisions, and stronger customer relationships - and Quitty is the key to making that future a reality.
Shared.Heading-text2: At Quitty, we believe in more than just eliminating paper receipts. We're revolutionizing how retailers interact with customers, manage transactions, and drive sustainable growth. Quitty provides a seamless, integrated digital receipt solution that not only reduces your environmental footprint but also empowers you with real-time insights, loyalty integration, and enhanced customer engagement.
Shared.Mission-text: We empower retailers to reduce their carbon footprint while fostering innovation, sustainability, and stronger customer relationships through the adoption of digital receipts and eco-friendly business practices.
Shared.Vision-title: Transform Retail for a Greener Future
Shared.Vision-text: We envision a world where every transaction is paperless, retailers thrive with data-driven insights, and consumers enjoy seamless, eco-friendly shopping experiences. We're committed to building a sustainable retail ecosystem.

Process.title: Digital Receipts,Made Effortless
Process.text: Quitty's process is designed to be simple for both retailers and customers. Here's how it works:
Process.listText1: When a customer completes their purchase, they are asked if they would like a digital receipt.
Process.listText2: The receipt is sent instantly to their smartphone, accessible via the Quitty app or email.
Process.listText3: Customers automatically collect loyalty points with every purchase, encouraging repeat visits.
Process.listText4: Both customers and retailers receive categorized spending insights that provide actionable data on purchasing habits.

Features.title: The All-in-One Solution for Retailers
Features.listText1: Say goodbye to paper clutter. Quitty's digital receipts are delivered instantly to your customers' phones, providing an eco-friendly, modern alternative to printed receipts.
Features.listText2: Engage customers like never before. Quitty's integrated loyalty program allows customers to collect points with every purchase and redeem them for rewards, increasing retention and driving repeat business.
Features.listText3: Quitty's real-time data analytics offer both customers and retailers deep insights into purchasing behavior, spending categories, and trends. These insights allow retailers to create more targeted marketing strategies.
Features.listText4: Reduce your carbon footprint by eliminating the need for paper receipts. Quitty helps your business achieve its sustainability goals while responding to the growing demand for eco-friendly practices.
Features.listText1-2: Reduces paper costs, eliminates waste, and enhances the customer experience with a seamless digital option.
Features.listText2-2: Boost customer loyalty and increase sales with personalized rewards that incentivize repeat visits.
Features.listText3-2: Make data-driven decisions to optimize inventory, tailor promotions, and improve customer experience.
Features.listText4-2: Build a strong, eco-conscious brand image that resonates with today's environmentally aware consumers.

Cookies.Title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.Paragraph1-1: 1. Introduction This cookie policy informs you about the nature, purpose, and scope of the use of cookies and similar technologies on the Quitty website (quitty.ch). Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you access our website. They allow us to store certain information about you or your device, thereby improving the user experience.
Cookies.Paragraph1-2: 2. Use of Cookies We use cookies to: Ensure the functionality and security of our website. Optimize user-friendliness and improve website performance. Create statistics on website usage. Personalize our content and advertising efforts.
Cookies.Paragraph1-3: 3. Types of Cookies Our website uses various types of cookies to ensure an optimal user experience and functionality: a. Necessary Cookies These cookies are required to ensure basic functions of the website, such as access to secure areas. Without them, the website may not function properly. Name: SESSION_ID Purpose: Stores the user session. Provider: quitty.ch Type: HTTP Cookie Expiration: Session Name: XSRF-TOKEN Purpose: Protection against Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks. Provider: quitty.ch Type: HTTP Cookie Expiration: Session b. Functional Cookies These cookies allow for improved performance and functionality, such as storing your language preferences. Rejecting these cookies may affect the user experience. Name: LANGUAGE_PREFPurpose: Stores the user's preferred language. Provider: quitty.ch Type: HTTP Cookie Expiration: 1 year c. Analytical and Personalization Cookies These cookies collect data about user behavior to create anonymous reports and statistics, and tailor content to users' interests. Name: _ga Purpose: Google Analytics to differentiate users and create usage statistics. Provider: Google LLC Type: HTTP Cookie Expiration: 2 years Name: _gid Purpose: Differentiation of users for reliable usage analysis. Provider: Google LLC Type: HTTP Cookie Expiration: 24 hours d. Marketing and Tracking Cookies These cookies enable us to show personalized content and ads to users and measure the effectiveness of campaigns. Name: IDE Purpose: Used by Google DoubleClick to analyze user actions after viewing or clicking an ad. Provider: Google LLC Type: HTTP Cookie Expiration: 1 year e. Unclassified Cookies These cookies are currently not categorized and are being analyzed. Name: test_cookie Purpose: Tests if the browser allows setting cookies.  Provider: Google LLC Type: HTTP Cookie Expiration: 15 minutes
Cookies.Paragraph1-4: 4. Managing and Deleting Cookies You can individually adjust your cookie settings or delete cookies via your browser settings. Please note that rejecting cookies may limit the functionality of our website. Below are links to guides for common browsers: Chrome Firefox Safari Edge Opera
Cookies.Paragraph1-5: 5. Cookie Settings We use a cookie management tool that allows you to manage different cookie categories and adjust your preferences at any time. This tool is displayed when you first visit our website and is always accessible through the cookie icon at the bottom of the page.
Cookies.Paragraph1-6: 6. Third-Party Integrations and Their Cookies In certain cases, we use third-party cookies for analytical or advertising purposes: Google Analytics - for web analytics to understand website usage and improve performance. Privacy Policy: [Google Analytics Privacy Policy] Facebook Pixel - for measuring and optimizing our advertising campaigns. Privacy Policy: [Facebook Privacy Policy]
Cookies.Paragraph1-7: 7. Changes to the Cookie Policy We reserve the right to change or supplement this cookie policy at any time. Changes will be published on this page and will be effective from the date of publication.
